> - **Our Mission** — full content vs our-mission.html
> - **Book a Demo** — Calendly + supporting copy
> - **Scope** — 4 platform tabs (Shopify / WordPress / Shopify Apps / Frontend) × 4 tier tabs (Small/Medium/Large/Support) — every card content vs scope.html
> - **Testimonials** — every quote vs testimonials.html
> - **Privacy / Terms / Newsletter** — body copy exact
> - **Services** — website-development full + 3 coming-soon shells matching Webflow
>
> **D13. Shared components**
> - **Navbar** — sticky trigger 300px desktop / 350px mobile, Solutions dropdown (Web Dev link + 3 Coming Soon), "View Full Service Scope" link, Resources dropdown (Blog + help.boldteq.com), Login (portal.boldteq.com) + Schedule Demo CTAs, mobile sheet 300px #082753
> - **Footer** — newsletter card + 4 link cols (About/Services/Resources/Help), Coming Soon badges, logo + LinkedIn/IG/FB icons, "Designed with ❤️ from India 🇮🇳"
> - **Beta CTA** — bottom of most pages: 🔒 Exclusive + 4 checkmarks, Founding Partner Pricing + 15-agency urgency, modal close (✕ / Esc / overlay)
> - **Newsletter signup** — email + submit + privacy line above BetaCta

> - Blog: 6 posts surface, categories filter works, HTML content renders sanitized

> ### Tooling — required commands
> ```bash
> pnpm build                           # D9
> pnpm lint                            # D9
> grep -rn ": any\b\|as any\|@ts-ignore\|@ts-expect-error\|console\.\(log\|warn\)\|debugger" src

>     "dimension": "D1",
